- Finance prefers issuing two distinct invoices for the 60/40 split (clean for revenue recognition).
- For US bill-to addresses we do not add VAT; if billing country is within EU/UK we need the customer VAT ID to determine reverse charge or collect VAT.
- Please document PO 6734 on both invoices and reference the parent invoice number on the second invoice for audit (example: INV-2026-178 and INV-2026-178-2).
- We can accept split by wire or ACH. Wire is preferred for faster posting.
- Suggest adding a 1.5% late fee applied after 15 days late on the second installment (we've negotiated this occasionally for split invoices).

Rafael — can you confirm the bank details and whether finance needs any additional docs to allow split payments for this deal?
